verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Wise serves an llms.txt at https://docs.wise.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and its API reference pages are published as Markdown (.md) endpoints an agent can ingest, so the story is delivered as written. missing for 10: first-party docs explaining agent or llms.txt usage, any llms-full.txt or broader agent-oriented content, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the main Platform API (only the legacy webhook spec is listed in llms.txt), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
